---
description: "Use when wiring, debugging, or extending a /change command production handler (explore/propose/refine/review/implement/verify/finish/status/resume) or files under src/change/**, src/controller/**."
---

# `/change` production wiring

- The `/change` surface lives in `src/change/`, in two layers: `handlers/` holds exactly one thin module per command (`explore.ts`, `propose.ts`, `refine.ts`, `review.ts`, `implement.ts`, `resume.ts`, `verify.ts`, `finish.ts`, `status.ts`), and `phases/` holds every phase runner regardless of how many commands use it. A handler interprets arguments and calls one phase — never the other way round; `tests/muster/module-layout.test.ts` enforces this. `src/change/dependencies.ts` (`createProductionChangeCommandDependencies`) wires the handlers together — check `docs/roadmap.md` first for which handlers already have a production implementation; passing controller/library unit tests do not mean the handler is wired to real I/O.
- Write a handler with `defineChangeHandler(action, run)` from `src/change/handler.ts`. It normalizes the invocation once (change name typed by the action's declaration, joined prompt, merged signal, run id, agent observer, actor, memoized snapshot) and stamps the action and change name onto the outcome. Declare the action's argument shape, change requirement, lifecycle gating and run identity in `src/change/commands.ts`; parsing, usage text and dispatch are derived from that table.
- Resolve models with `resolveModelStack`/`roleModel` from `src/change/models.ts`: `MUSTER_<ROLE>_MODEL` env override > `--fh-config <path>` YAML slot > CLI flag > one declared fallback per role. Never add a second fallback in a phase.
- Reuse `src/agents/legacy-adapter.ts::runLegacyReadOnlyChild` (built on `src/agents/child-runner.ts::runBrokeredChild`) as the "spawn one read-only agent" primitive; it does not need the live extension `ctx`, only `cwd`, a model, and a scratch session dir.
- Return the outcome and let the dispatcher post it: `emitOutcome` hands it to `context.sendMessage` (a durable transcript panel tagged with `MUSTER_CUSTOM_TYPE` and carrying structured details) and falls back to `context.ui.notify` only when no host renderer is available, e.g. in tests. `ui.notify` is a transient toast and will not show multi-paragraph output.
- An action declared `args: "free-text"` in `src/change/commands.ts` has its whole remainder treated as a prompt with no positional `changeName`, so a stray word is never persisted as the active change. Declare the shape rather than special-casing the action in the dispatcher.
- After wiring a new handler, **smoke-test it live** (real `pi` child spawn) in addition to unit tests — several real bugs (stale extension paths, hardcoded models, wrong notify vs. sendMessage) only surface when a real child process actually runs; `bun test` never spawns one.
- Re-run `bun run ci:test` after each wiring slice and compare the pass/fail count against the pre-existing Windows-only baseline (symlink `EPERM`, path-separator fixtures) rather than expecting zero failures.
